name: shortest_path_unweighted
author: edba08e8
description: Finds the path with the fewest hops (edges) between two nodes using breadth-first search, ignoring edge weights. Use for questions like 'fewest flights from Chennai to Lisbon?', 'how many steps separate A and B?' or 'can I get from X to Y, and how?'. Works on directed graphs (follows edge direction) and undirected graphs. Needs node ids (use lookup_node first). Returns hops, and the path as a list of nodes with id and label; if no path exists it returns an error saying so.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, e.g. 'airports' or 'karate'.

source.description: Node id where the path starts, e.g. 'MAA'. Use lookup_node to find ids from names.

target.description: Node id where the path ends, e.g. 'LIS'. Use lookup_node to find ids from names.
